files.description: Glob selecting the files of an any-file predicate.

command.description: Runs a program (no shell) in the project root with a scrubbed environment; only with --allow-exec.

pass_files.description: Hand the scoped files to the program as arguments or NUL-separated on stdin.

path.description: May use {path}, {dir}, {stem}, {ext}, {rel} of each scoped file.

llm.description: Asks a model whether the changed lines satisfy a checklist. Advisory (never above warning), only with --allow-llm; allowed only as the root predicate or directly under `all`.

for_each.description: A literal path with {rel}, or a glob.

description: Schema for config.local.toml (ai-rulez.local.toml beside a root ai-rulez.toml) machine-local overlay files merged onto the shared ai-rulez config

$comment.description: Free-form note, ignored by ai-rulez (accepted so a config can carry a comment)

$schema.description: Reference to this schema for editor support

agents_md.description: When true, always-on rules and context are rendered once into a shared AGENTS.md (nested <scope>/AGENTS.md for scopes) and skills once into .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, instead of per-tool copies. Presets that read these files skip their own copies. Defaults to true in v5: AGENTS.md is the canonical instruction file and tools that do not read it import it. Set false for per-tool outputs.

agents_md_split.description: With the agents source, read the root AGENTS.md as one context item per H2 heading instead of one item. Items are named agents-<heading slug> (agents for the text before the first heading, -2, -3 for a repeated heading), so `list context` and `remove context` address them; removing one deletes that section from AGENTS.md. Headings inside code fences do not split. Needs source = "agents" or a configuration in .agents/ai-rulez.toml. Default false (AGENTS.md is one item named agents).

ard.description: Agentic Resource Discovery manifest (ard.json, spec v0.91, a proposal). Identifiers are urn:air:<publisher>:<namespace>:<name>. Emitted by `ai-rulez publish --emit ard`; see docs/ard.md.

base_url.description: https URL the skill files (skills/<name>/SKILL.md, written next to ard.json) are served from. Without it skills point at the raw file of the release tag and plugins at the release archive.

namespace.description: Identifier segment between publisher and name; colons separate sub-segments.

plugin_type.description: Media type of plugin entries. Default application/vnd.ai-rulez.plugin+json, because the spec registers none.

publisher.description: Fully qualified domain name the identifiers are anchored to, normally the domain that serves /.well-known/ard.json.

queries.description: representativeQueries (2 to 5) of a skill, MCP server or plugin by name, replacing the ones derived from skill frontmatter and eval cases.

builtins.description: Built-in domains to include. Use `true` to enable all, `false` to disable all, or an array of specific names. Prefix with '!' to exclude an entire auto-included domain (e.g., '!ai-governance'), or use '!domain/name' to exclude one item (rule, skill, agent, command or context file) while keeping the rest of the domain (e.g., '!git-workflow/commit-messages'). A positive 'domain/name' (e.g., 'docker/container-standards') loads only that item of the pack; 'domain' wins over 'domain/name', and the item still applies after '!domain' (['security/secrets-handling', '!security'] loads only that item). '!domain/name' always removes the item. Available: ai-governance (auto), agent-delegation (auto), security (auto), git-workflow (auto), code-quality (auto), testing (auto), token-efficiency (auto), documentation, polyglot-bindings, default-commands, cicd, observability, docker, rust, python, typescript, go, java, ruby, php, elixir, csharp, r, pyo3, napi-rs, magnus, ext-php-rs, rustler, wasm, jni-rs, extendr, cgo, vite-plus. An unknown positive entry (pack or item) fails validation and names the valid choices; an unknown exclusion is only a warning.

oneOf.description: true = enable all builtins, false = disable all (including auto-includes)

bundle_exclude.description: Extra patterns for files left out of skill and command resource bundles (the SKILL.md Resources section and the copied files), added to the always-skipped .git, .venv*, venv, __pycache__, *.pyc and node_modules. A pattern without '/' matches any path segment; one with '/' matches the path relative to the skill directory. Files ignored by .gitignore are skipped too.

catalog.description: Defaults for `ai-rulez catalog` and its static site (see docs/catalog.md). A command-line flag overrides each key.

exclude_owners.description: Leave owner names out of the catalog JSON and the site. Default false.

include_excerpt.description: Include a body excerpt of each item. Default: true, except for an indexable site.

indexable.description: Let search engines index the site (no robots.txt, no noindex). Default false.

max_items_per_page.description: Overview rows per page of the static site. 0 or unset: 200.

render_markdown.description: Render item excerpts as sanitized Markdown (no raw HTML, links shown as text) instead of plain text. Default false.

title.description: Title of the static site. Default: AI-Rulez catalog.

claude_md.description: Controls the CLAUDE.md the claude preset writes when agents_md is on. 'shim' (the default) keeps the '@AGENTS.md' import file; 'none' writes only AGENTS.md, which Claude Code 2.1.277 and later reads directly, and removes a previously generated shim.

settings.description: Opt-in management of the plugin keys of .claude/settings.json. Only the listed entries are owned; every other key survives.

disable_plugins.description: Plugin names written as enabledPlugins."<name>@<marketplace>": false.

enable_plugins.description: Plugin names written as enabledPlugins."<name>@<marketplace>": true.

managed.description: Further keys of .claude/settings.json owned entry by entry. Declaring an entry is the opt-in; `manage` is not required.

env.description: Owns env.<NAME> for every listed variable.

skill_overrides.description: Owns skillOverrides.<skill> for every listed skill.

marketplace_source.description: Source written for the marketplace. Default: a directory source at marketplace.output_dir.

register_marketplace.description: Own extraKnownMarketplaces.<marketplace.name>. Default true when manage is set.

skills.description: Options for the skills written to .claude/skills.

hide_from_menu.description: Write user-invocable: false on every skill that does not set the key itself, so Claude Code hides it from the / menu and only the model loads it. Off by default: a skill without the key is user-invocable. A user-invocable value set in the skill's frontmatter always wins.

project_doc_max_bytes.description: The project_doc_max_bytes your Codex is configured with. generate warns when the AGENTS.md files Codex concatenates (root down to a directory) exceed it, naming the largest sections. Unset means the Codex default of 32 KiB; 0 turns the warning off.

codex_skills_dir.description: Where the codex preset writes skills, relative to the project root. Defaults to '.agents/skills', the location Codex documents. Set '.codex/skills' to keep the location used before 4.24.

compact.description: When true, omit per-rule '**Priority:**' annotations from generated inline rule sections to reduce output size. Defaults to false.

default.description: Default profile name to use when --profile is not specified

default_layers.description: Layer names (config.<name>.toml beside config.toml, or in .agents/.ai-rulez/ for an .agents project; not supported in a root ai-rulez.toml) that are always merged over this file, in order, before any layer AI_RULEZ_LAYERS names. A listed layer with no file is an error. Ignored inside a layer.

defaults.description: Top-level defaults that propagate into generated outputs when individual content files do not override them

effort.description: Default reasoning effort applied across providers that support it. Each preset maps the value to its own vocabulary.

effort_by_preset.description: Per-preset reasoning effort overrides. Beats `effort` for the matching preset; per-agent metadata still wins where the preset supports it.

model_by_preset.description: Per-preset model overrides for agents. Beats the legacy agent-level `model` field for the matching preset; per-agent `<preset>_model` frontmatter still wins. Presets that do not emit a per-agent model frontmatter ignore entries here.

omit_agent_fields.description: Agent frontmatter fields to suppress for every preset, so an agent stays loadable where a field is invalid (unconfigured model/provider, unrecognized tool name). Values: model, effort, tools, description.

delivery.description: How served skills are presented to the agent (dynamic skill loading).

stub.description: Customises the generated dynamic-skills stub skill that tells an MCP-capable agent to call find_skill and load_skill. Unset fields keep the built-in text.

body.description: Replaces the stub's text. {{server}} is the MCP server that serves the skills. It must still tell the agent to call find_skill and load_skill. Mutually exclusive with body_file.

body_file.description: Reads the stub's text from a file, relative to the config directory and inside it. Same rules as body. Mutually exclusive with body.

description.description: Replaces the stub's frontmatter description, which every session lists.

delivery.description: Default delivery of the domain's skills. A skill's own `delivery` frontmatter wins.

domains.description: Per-domain settings, keyed by domain name.

gitignore.description: Opt in to a managed block in .gitignore listing the generated output patterns. Off by default in v5 (committed outputs are not ignored); machine-local outputs are always ignored

gitignore_exclude.description: Ignore patterns left out of the managed .gitignore block, for generated outputs the project commits on purpose (for example AGENTS.md, **/CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/, .opencode/skills/). Gitignore notation: an entry without '/' matches at any depth, '**' crosses directories, a trailing '/' names a directory and covers what is below it. Machine-local and secret outputs are never excluded. Each root applies its own list to its own outputs. Has no effect unless the block is written

governance.description: Which pinned content needs a recorded reviewer approval in ai-rulez.lock (see docs/approvals.md).

approvers.description: Allowlist of reviewer strings (exact match). Empty allows any reviewer. An @org/team entry is expanded through teams.

approvers_from.description: CODEOWNERS (found in .github/, the root or docs/) or a path inside the project to a CODEOWNERS file: only the owners of an item's source path may approve it.

enforce.description: Make lock --check, generate --locked and mcp --serve-skills fail on content whose approval is missing, stale, expired or insufficient. validate reports it either way.

exempt.description: Globs over kind:id or kind:domain/id (* matches any run of characters) that never need approval.

forbid_self_approval.description: Reject an approval by an author of the content it approves (commit authors of the item's path since the base revision).

max_age.description: Default lifetime of a new approval, such as 365d or 720h. Empty means no expiry.

min_approvers.description: Distinct reviewers that must approve one digest. Default 1.

min_assurance.description: Weakest assurance an approval may have to count. Default asserted.

require_approval.description: Content that needs approval: remote (includes, installed skills, skill sources, remote served skills), local (every authored item), all, or kind:<kind> (kind:hook, kind:mcp_server, kind:skill, ...).

teams.description: Maps a team (@org/team) to the reviewers it stands for, so teams in approvers and CODEOWNERS resolve offline.

guard.description: Built-in generated-file guard. With generated = true, generation adds a PreToolUse hook that runs `ai-rulez guard` and blocks an agent's edit to a file ai-rulez generated, telling it to edit the source under .ai-rulez/ instead. Written only for harnesses with a documented blocking PreToolUse hook (claude, codex, gemini, cursor, factory). A separate table because `[hooks]` cannot coexist with the `[[hooks]]` array.

command.description: Replace the whole launch command (executable followed by its arguments, without the trailing "guard"), for example ["ai-rulez"] for a locally installed binary. Mutually exclusive with version; requires generated = true.

version.description: Pin the ai-rulez version the hook runs through npx. Defaults to the version of the binary that runs generate, or "latest" for a dev build. Requires generated = true.

header.description: Header style configuration for generated files

hashes.description: Freshness lines in generated headers: full writes Content-Hash and Source-Hash; content (default) keeps only the per-file Content-Hash so editing one source no longer rewrites a line in every generated file; none writes neither.

mcp_line.description: Name the ai-rulez MCP server in generated headers ("Use MCP server: ..."). The command is derived from [mcp] (self_server_command, self_server_version, and --serve-skills when skills are served) and is left out while mcp.self_server is false. Set to false to drop the line from every header.

nested.description: Header of a root that sits inside another ai-rulez root of the same git repository: compact (default) writes one line, "Generated by ai-rulez from <config path>; do not edit"; omit writes no header; inherit repeats the outer root's header. A custom text is kept unless nested is set explicitly.

style.description: Header style: detailed (comprehensive), compact (concise), or minimal (bare minimum)

text.description: Author-supplied header text that replaces the prose generated from `style`. It is wrapped in the output's comment syntax and still carries the Content-Hash / Source-Hash freshness lines. Use TOML multi-line syntax to span lines.

timestamp.description: Emit the "Generated:" line in generated headers. Off by default so generated output is byte-reproducible; set to true to opt the line back in, and pin it with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH if reproducibility still matters.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks rendered into each harness's native project settings (.claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json, .cursor/hooks.json, .gemini/settings.json, .github/hooks/ai-rulez.json), outside any plugin. Events use Claude Code names; a group a harness cannot express is skipped with a warning.

event.description: Claude Code lifecycle event, e.g. PreToolUse. Unknown events are warned about, not rejected.

items.description: One hook handler. Exactly one of 'command' or 'script' is required.

if.description: claude only; a handler with `if` is skipped elsewhere.

script.description: Project-relative script, addressed through the harness's project-root variable (user scope: relative to the user config directory).

timeout.description: Seconds; converted to milliseconds for gemini.

matcher.description: Filters which occurrences of the event run the group. Copied to the harnesses that share Claude Code's tool names (claude, codex, qwen, codebuddy, qoder, letta, grok, deepagents, junie, zcode); other harnesses need matchers.<harness>.

matchers.description: Per-harness matcher overriding `matcher`, for harnesses that name tools differently.

targets.description: Restrict the group to these harnesses. Default: every harness the group can be expressed for.

improve.description: Defaults of `ai-rulez improve run`: the held-out split, the acceptance gate, limits and the optimizer. A flag always wins. `optimizer` and `env_pass` take effect from a repository config only with --trust-repo-optimizer. See docs/improve.md.

env_pass.description: Environment variable names forwarded to the optimizer. From a repository config only with --trust-repo-optimizer.

holdout_fraction.description: Deterministic held-out share when no case carries the tag (default 0.3).

holdout_tag.description: Eval cases carrying this tag are held out (default holdout).

isolation.description: How the optimizer is confined: none (default) never confines it, auto confines when a sandbox backend works, require refuses to run without one.

max_holdout_evals.description: Times the held-out set may be evaluated (default 3).

max_regressions.description: Held-out cases allowed to flip from pass to fail (default 0).

max_skill_growth.description: Largest SKILL.md growth, as a factor of its original token count (default 1.25, at most 2).

min_gain.description: Held-out pass-rate gain a candidate needs (default 0.05).

min_holdout_cases.description: Fewest scored held-out cases a run needs (default and floor 3).

optimizer.description: Optimizer command (argv, no shell) or builtin:<adapter>. From a repository config only with --trust-repo-optimizer.

require_ci_above_zero.description: Make the lower end of the 95% bootstrap interval of the held-out gain a gate condition (default false).

runs.description: Eval runs per case and arm; the majority outcome counts (default 3).

includes.description: Content sources (git repositories or local paths) to include and merge

format.description: Read the source as an Open Knowledge Format bundle (a directory or git repository; path selects the bundle directory) and convert it to rules, context and skills at load time. See docs/okf.md.

include.description: What content types to import (defaults to all). MCP servers are not importable from an include.

include_prerelease.description: Allow prerelease tags (1.3.0-rc.1) that the constraint does not itself name. Default false. Needs version.

install_to.description: Import content into a specific domain (defaults to root)

local_override.description: Local path or content that overrides the include when present

merge_strategy.description: How to handle conflicting files: local-override (default, local wins), include-override (include wins), or error (fail on conflict)

min_release_age.description: Hold back a tag younger than this age (7d, 12h, 2w; a number with h, d or w; 0 disables) when `ai-rulez lock` or `ai-rulez update` picks the newest allowed tag. Defaults to [lock] min_release_age. Needs version. See docs/lockfile.md.

path.description: Path within git repository to .ai-rulez/ or domain folder (git repos only)

ref.description: Git ref - branch, tag, or commit hash (git repos only). Defaults to the remote's default branch.

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

source.description: Git repository URL (https://...) or local file path (absolute or relative). A URL must not embed a credential (https://user:token@host/...): authenticate with the git credential helper or the AI_RULEZ_GIT_TOKEN environment variable instead; a committed credential is reported as AR035.

tag_prefix.description: Only tags that start with this prefix are version tags, for a repository that tags several sources (deploy/v for deploy/v2.1.3). Default: a plain version or one after a single v. Needs version.

version.description: npm-style version constraint resolved against the repository's semantic version tags (^1.2, ~2.1.0, >=1.4.0 <2.0.0, 1.x || 3). `ai-rulez lock` pins the chosen tag, its commit and the tree digest; only `ai-rulez update` moves the pin. Set either `ref` or `version`, not both (AR731). Git sources only. See docs/lockfile.md.

installed_marketplaces.description: Plugin marketplaces the project reads: a Claude Code (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json), Codex (.agents/plugins/marketplace.json) or Cursor (.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json) index in a repository, a local directory or at an https URL. An [[installed_plugins]] entry installs a plugin from one. See docs/installed-plugins.md.

include_prerelease.description: Allow prerelease tags that the constraint does not itself name. Default false. Needs version.

min_release_age.description: Hold back a tag younger than this age (7d, 12h, 2w; 0 disables). Defaults to [lock] min_release_age. Needs version.

name.description: Marketplace name (unique identifier), referenced by installed_plugins[].marketplace

path.description: Directory of the repository that holds the marketplace index (defaults to the repository root)

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit hash (repository sources only)

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

source.description: A repository URL (https://, ssh, git@host:path, file://), a GitHub owner/repo shorthand, a local directory (./path, inside the project) or an https URL of a marketplace.json. A URL must not embed a credential.

tag_prefix.description: Only tags that start with this prefix are version tags. Needs version.

trust.description: Security-scan level for the plugins read through this marketplace. error (default) blocks on any finding; warn blocks only findings that are errors by their own severity.

version.description: npm-style version constraint resolved against the repository's semantic version tags (^1.2, ~2.1.0, >=1.4.0 <2.0.0, 1.x || 3). `ai-rulez lock` pins the chosen tag, its commit and the tree digest; only `ai-rulez update` moves the pin. Set either `ref` or `version`, not both (AR731). Repository sources only. See docs/lockfile.md.

installed_plugins.description: Plugins whose skills, agents, commands, hooks and MCP servers the project imports, read through an installed marketplace or straight from a plugin repository or directory. Hooks stay off unless enable_hooks is set. See docs/installed-plugins.md.

domain.description: Place the imported content in the named domain. MCP servers are scoped to it; hooks are not scoped.

enable_hooks.description: Import the plugin's hooks. Off by default: a hook runs a command on every machine that uses the project.

enable_mcp.description: Import the plugin's MCP servers. On by default.

exclude.description: Do not import these component kinds; wins over include.

format.description: Force the plugin layout instead of detecting it.

include_prerelease.description: Allow prerelease tags that the constraint does not itself name. Default false. Needs version.

marketplace.description: Name of an installed_marketplaces entry. Exclusive with source.

min_release_age.description: Hold back a tag younger than this age (7d, 12h, 2w; 0 disables). Defaults to [lock] min_release_age. Needs version.

name_prefix.description: Prepended to every imported skill, agent, command and MCP server name (and to the output directory of a skill).

path.description: Directory of the plugin inside the repository (source only)

plugin.description: The marketplace entry to install when it is not called like this entry (needs marketplace).

profiles.description: Restrict the imported content and MCP servers to the named profiles.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit hash (source only)

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

source.description: A plugin repository or directory: repository URL, GitHub owner/repo shorthand or a local directory (./path, inside the project). Exclusive with marketplace.

tag_prefix.description: Only tags that start with this prefix are version tags. Needs version.

trust.description: Security-scan level for the imported content. error (default) blocks on any finding; warn blocks only findings that are errors by their own severity.

version.description: npm-style version constraint resolved against the repository's semantic version tags (^1.2, ~2.1.0, >=1.4.0 <2.0.0, 1.x || 3). `ai-rulez lock` pins the chosen tag, its commit and the tree digest; only `ai-rulez update` moves the pin. Set either `ref` or `version`, not both (AR731). Repository sources only. See docs/lockfile.md.

installed_skills.description: Named skills to install from external repositories. Skills are fetched dynamically during generation.

domain.description: Place this installed skill in the named domain, so profile and role selection include it exactly like a local domain skill. Omit to keep it in the root content. When both domain and profiles are set, both must match.

exclude.description: Drop skills whose directory name matches one of these globs; wins over include.

include.description: Keep only skills whose directory name matches one of these globs, so one entry can select several skills from one repository.

include_prerelease.description: Allow prerelease tags (1.3.0-rc.1) that the constraint does not itself name. Default false. Needs version.

local_override.description: Local path override for development (used instead of source when present)

min_release_age.description: Hold back a tag younger than this age (7d, 12h, 2w; a number with h, d or w; 0 disables) when `ai-rulez lock` or `ai-rulez update` picks the newest allowed tag. Defaults to [lock] min_release_age. Needs version. See docs/lockfile.md.

name_prefix.description: Prepended to every resolved skill name and to its output directory, so two entries cannot collide.

path.description: Path within repository to skill directory (defaults to skills/<name>)

profiles.description: Restrict this skill to the named profiles. Omit to include it in every profile.

ref.description: Git ref - branch, tag, or commit hash (git repos only)

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

resources.description: What is bundled from each skill's directory besides references/, scripts/ and assets/ (always bundled). By default an installed skill is bundled whole: every file except SKILL.md, evals/, agents/ and hidden files. Setting resources replaces that default. A pattern is a name, a path or a glob (a name matches a file or directory at any depth); a leading ! removes what an earlier pattern added, for example ["*", "!docs"].

source.description: Git repository URL (https://...), GitHub shorthand (owner/repo or github:owner/repo), file:// URL, or local directory (a relative or absolute path, or ~/path in config.local.toml or the user config only). A local path in the project config must stay inside the project. A URL must not embed a credential (https://user:token@host/...): authenticate with the git credential helper or the AI_RULEZ_GIT_TOKEN environment variable instead; a committed credential is reported as AR035.

tag_prefix.description: Only tags that start with this prefix are version tags, for a repository that tags several sources (deploy/v for deploy/v2.1.3). Default: a plain version or one after a single v. Needs version.

trust.description: Security-scan level for this entry's imported skills. error (default) blocks on any finding; warn blocks only findings that are errors by their own severity (secrets, hidden characters, risky shell).

version.description: npm-style version constraint resolved against the repository's semantic version tags (^1.2, ~2.1.0, >=1.4.0 <2.0.0, 1.x || 3). `ai-rulez lock` pins the chosen tag, its commit and the tree digest; only `ai-rulez update` moves the pin. Set either `ref` or `version`, not both (AR731). Git sources only. See docs/lockfile.md.

judge.description: Settings of `ai-rulez judge`: which categories run, how a run gates, what is attached to a unit, rubric skills, prompt extensions and quote-pinned suppressions. The keys marked "User scope only" are honoured from the user config file, the environment and flags only; a repository value is ignored and reported. See docs/judge.md.

allow_llm.description: User scope only. Agree to send content to the model's provider without --allow-llm.

allow_prompt_override.description: User scope only. Let an `override` prompt from a repository file take effect.

attach_claude_md.description: Attach the CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md and AGENTS.md files (with their @imports) of every ancestor directory. Default true.

attach_rules.description: Attach the path-scoped rules (every ancestor D/.claude/rules/**/*.md, globs relative to D) that govern a unit to its governance review. Default true.

concurrency.description: User scope only. Calls in flight at once (default 4).

fail_on.description: Gate entries: <category>:<severity>, <category>:none, score:<n> or <category>:score:<n>. Default security:high, governance:high, quality:none. A category the list does not name keeps its default.

max_calls.description: User scope only. Call cap of a run.

max_cost_usd.description: User scope only. Spend cap of a run in USD.

max_tokens.description: User scope only. Token cap of a run.

min_confidence.description: Findings below this confidence are dropped from the report (default low).

models.description: User scope only. Model of each role: security, quality, governance, adjudicator, or reviewers for the first three.

file.description: Prompt text, relative to the project root.

prompts.description: Extend or replace a category's role prompt: [judge.prompts.security] mode = "extend", file = ".ai-rulez/judge/security.md". The evidence contract, the trust tiers and the output schema cannot be changed. An override outside the user config also needs --allow-prompt-override.

rpm.description: User scope only. Calls started per minute (0 = no limit).

skills.description: Rubric skills: skills whose `## C1 - title` sections are criteria a unit is judged against.

for.description: Skills per category, for example { quality = ["my-rubric"] }.

load.description: Skill names applied to the governance review. A name is looked up in the project's skill directories.

pins.description: Skill name to the start of its SHA-256. A matching pinned skill is configured text (T1); an unpinned or changed one is reference data (T2).

suppress.description: Known findings to silence. Each is pinned to the quote it was made for (a changed text brings the finding back) and expires.

code.description: A finding code such as JR-S05.

path.description: The file, or a glob relative to the project root.

quote.description: The finding's quote, or a part of it.

traps_file.description: YAML list of repository false-positive shapes the adjudicator is told about (default .ai-rulez/judge/traps.yaml).

accept.description: Accepts single findings with a required reason: the findings of one rule in one file whose message holds match (or that sit on line) stay in the report, marked accepted, and do not fail the run. An entry that matches nothing is reported as AR9I0.

line.description: The 1-based line the finding must be reported on.

match.description: Substring the finding's message must contain (case-sensitive). Set match, line or both.

path.description: Glob, relative to the config directory or the repository root, of the source file; an exact path is a glob without wildcards.

reason.description: Why the finding is acceptable; required.

rule.description: One finding code (AR007) or name (tool-breadth); no wildcards.

agents_md_only.description: Report (AR9Q0) every tracked CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md that is not the generated "@AGENTS.md" shim, when AGENTS.md is canonical for Claude Code. Off by default.

agents_md_only_allow.description: Path globs (relative to the config directory or the repo root) of CLAUDE.md files AR9Q0 accepts as intentional islands.

allow_overrides.description: Content names (`name`) or domain-qualified names (`domain/name`) whose shadowing of another copy is intentional, so AR703 does not report them. `name` or `preset:name` (for example `claude:init`) also acknowledges a skill or command that overrides a built-in (AR808).

allow_paths.description: Globs of repo paths that may be referenced without existing in the tracked tree.

allowed_keys.description: Frontmatter keys accepted in addition to the built-in Agent Skills, Claude Code and ai-rulez keys (AR303).

analyzers.description: Allow-list of lint analyzers (security, references, hooks, ...): only these run. `validate --analyzer` replaces it for one run. Empty runs every analyzer.

budgets.description: Size limits per content kind (rule, context, skill, agent, command), each a table with max_lines and max_tokens. 0 keeps the default, negative removes the limit. Tolerated findings per rule are [lint.ratchet], not this table.

builtin_names.description: Checks for a skill, command or agent named like a built-in of a harness that loads it (AR9U0) or like a name the harness refuses to load (AR9U1). The tables are in internal/harnessnames; project additions go in .ai-rulez/harness-names/<preset>.toml.

allow.description: Collisions that are intended: "name" (any harness) or "preset:name". Does not silence AR9U1. lint.allow_overrides is honoured the same way.

enabled.description: false turns AR9U0 and AR9U1 off (default true).

extra.description: Built-in names the embedded table cannot know, per preset: organization commands, MCP prompts, plugin skills, user-level skills.

max_network_commands.description: Network commands an item may run before AR030 reports it as network-heavy. Default 5.

evals.description: evals-missing check (AR962): skills with no eval cases. A skill has cases when its evals/ directory or .ai-rulez/evals/<skill>/ holds a file.

allow.description: Skill names or globs exempt from the check.

confusion_threshold.description: Enable skill-confusable (AR9A2): report a sibling that won at least this share of a skill's positive activation prompts.

estimate.description: Assumptions of the `ai-rulez eval run` cost estimate. `ai-rulez eval calibrate-estimate` proposes measured values. Zero or unset keeps the built-in value.

activation_output_tokens.description: Output tokens per activation decision. Built-in 150.

assumed_output_tokens.description: Output tokens per agent run of a case run. Built-in 600.

overhead_tokens.description: The harness's own input tokens per agent run (system prompt, tools). Built-in 2000.

price_in_per_mtok.description: USD per million input tokens the runs are really billed at (prompt caching bills most input at a fraction of the list price). --price-in wins; 0 or unset keeps the built-in price table.

price_out_per_mtok.description: USD per million output tokens the runs are really billed at. --price-out wins; 0 or unset keeps the built-in price table.

tool_loop_factor.description: Scales the tool-loop re-read in the high figure. Built-in 1.

min_activation_precision.description: Enable activation-low (AR9A1): report a skill whose recorded activation precision is below this.

min_activation_recall.description: Enable activation-low (AR9A1): report a skill whose recorded activation recall (`ai-rulez eval run --mode activation`) is below this.

min_pass_rate.description: Enable eval-score-low (AR998): report a skill whose recorded eval pass rate (eval-results.json) is below this. Also the pass mark of `ai-rulez eval run`.

require_fresh.description: Enable eval-stale (AR997) at this severity: report a skill edited after its last recorded passing eval.

example_paths.description: Globs of files that document risky commands as examples: findings of the command-shaped rules (AR005, AR006, AR008) in them are dropped.

external.description: External scanners run with `validate --external` or `scan --external`. Without `inputs` the command gets the scanned file paths appended; with `inputs` it runs on a read-only staged copy. It prints SARIF 2.1.0 or a JSON list; findings are merged as AR011.

batch_size.description: Split the {skill_dirs} handed to the command into runs of at most this many skill directories, each with its own timeout and cached on its own. 0 (default) hands the scanner all of them at once. Needs {skill_dirs} in command, without {stage}, {root} or {files}.

cache_files.description: Globs, relative to the project root, of files the scanner reads besides the staged content (a rules file, a configuration). Their content is part of the result cache key, so editing one runs the scanner again. The script a command runs through a known interpreter (python3 scan.py, node scan.js, sh run.sh, uv run scan.py) is hashed without being listed.

command.description: The argv to run, without a shell. A relative command[0] is resolved against the project root. With `inputs` the scanner's working directory is the stage, so a relative script argument (`["python3", "tools/scan.py"]`) is not found there: write it as `{project}/tools/scan.py`.

egress.description: Whether content derived from the scanned files can leave the machine. Unset keeps the legacy full environment and is reported as AR9E1. false scrubs the environment and rejects known egress flags (AR9E4); true runs only when the scanner is named in --allow-egress.

env_pass.description: Extra environment variable names passed through the scrubbed environment. Proxy and credential-like names are rejected when egress is false (AR9E0).

fail_on.description: Lowest severity of this scanner's findings (AR011) that fails the run. Replaces [lint.scanner_policy] fail_on for this scanner and the run's own threshold (--strict, --fail-on) for its findings.

inputs.description: Stage a read-only copy of exactly these kinds of content in a scratch directory and run the scanner there with HOME and TMPDIR inside it. The command's placeholders {stage}, {root} (the stage root), {project} (the project root), {files}, {skill_dirs}, {out} and {tmp} are expanded as arguments, and no file path is appended.

max_message.description: Characters of a finding message kept in text output. Default 500 (or [lint.scanner_policy] max_message). A cut message ends in "..."; the JSON report (full_message) and SARIF output (properties.fullMessage) keep the whole text.

message_properties.description: SARIF result property paths whose values are appended to the finding message as "[name: value; ...]" (counted against max_message). A dotted path reads nested properties; "location.snippet" reads locations[0].physicalLocation.region.snippet.text. Values are sanitized like the message (control characters removed, whitespace collapsed, secrets masked). SARIF format only; a profile can set a default (skillspector: evidence, snippet).

parallel.description: Run up to this many batches at the same time (default 1). Each batch gets its own {out} file and temp directory. Same command requirement as batch_size.

profile.description: An embedded scanner profile: its command, format, inputs, egress declaration, severity map and flag deny-list are the defaults of this entry. egress cannot be declared weaker than the profile's.

required.description: A missing, outdated or failing scanner is an error instead of a notice.

severity_map.description: Maps a scanner rule id (glob) to a severity. Applied before any other mapping.

stage_exclude.description: Leave out the files of a staged skill directory that match a glob (same syntax as stage_globs); it wins over stage_globs. SKILL.md is always staged.

stage_globs.description: Narrow the files staged from each skill directory to the ones matching a glob (relative to the skill directory; a pattern with no slash matches at any depth, ** crosses directories). SKILL.md is always staged. Unset stages every regular file of the directory.

timeout.description: Go duration such as "90s". Default 2m, at most 15m (or [lint.scanner_policy] max_timeout). Bounds each run of the command: every batch of a batch_size scanner gets the whole timeout.

version.description: Version range the scanner's --version output must satisfy (">=1.0.0, <2"). A scanner outside it is not run (AR9E2).

version_command.description: The argv that prints the scanner's version for the `version` check. Default: `command[0] --version`, which names the launcher (python3, node, uvx) when command[0] is one. Runs from the project root in the scanner's isolation mode; needs `version`. `scanners doctor --external` applies the same check.

version_timeout.description: How long the version probe (`version_command`, else `command[0] --version`) may run, as a duration such as "30s". Default 10s. A probe that exceeds it is reported as "version probe timed out after Ns" (AR9E2), not as empty output; needs `version`.

fail_on.description: Lowest severity that makes strict validation exit non-zero. Defaults to error.

ignore.description: Finding codes (AR401) or names (path-missing) to drop.

ignore_paths.description: Globs, relative to the config directory, of source files whose findings are dropped.

ignore_rules.description: Rule-scoped ignores: findings of the listed rules in the listed files are dropped, every other finding in those files is kept.

paths.description: Globs, relative to the config directory or the repository root, of the source files the ignore covers.

reason.description: Why the findings are acceptable; for the reader.

rules.description: Finding codes (AR901) or names (claude-md-shadow); a pattern with a wildcard (AR9*) matches codes.

known_names.description: Skill, agent, rule or command names provided outside this tree.

lint_outputs.description: Also lint the generated files (the bytes generate writes) with the security, references and descriptions analyzers; findings carry source "output". The same as validate --outputs.

load_budgets.description: Overrides the harness load limits AR964 checks, keyed by the limit id (for example `claude-skill-listing`, `codex-agents-chain`, `cursor-rule-lines`); the value is in the limit's own unit. Not to be confused with `budgets`, the size limits per content kind.

max_age_days.description: A date older than this many days is stale (AR953). Date type only.

required.description: Report an item of the configured kinds that lacks the key (AR951).

metadata.description: Typed checks for frontmatter keys (top-level or inside `metadata`), keyed by the frontmatter key.

paths.description: Files and directories, relative to the project root, that validate and scan lint in addition to the content tree (for example a marketplace or skill kept outside .ai-rulez/). Each must resolve inside the project root; the command line's --path and --glob add to them.

profile.description: Preset of rule severities and the failure threshold. strict fails on warnings and promotes quality warnings to errors; permissive downgrades broken-reference errors to warnings and never weakens security rules. Explicit severity, fail_on and budget settings win over the preset.

ratchet.description: Tolerated finding count per rule code or name: a rule whose unaccepted findings number at most N does not count toward the exit code. Lower N over time to ratchet a rule down. Not the size limits: those are [lint.budgets.<kind>].

require_metadata.description: Frontmatter keys every item of a content kind must set. A key inside the Agent Skills `metadata` map counts.

risk.description: Weights of the advisory risk score shown next to the findings (never affects the exit code). Points per finding; the score is capped at 100.

scanner_policy.description: Policy for the external scanners as a whole: an embedded preset, required scanners, a failure threshold, isolation and which egress scanners may be allowed.

allow_egress.description: Scanners --allow-egress may enable. Unset, the flag alone decides; set (even empty), the name must also be listed. Presets never read it.

baseline.description: Scanner baseline file, relative to the project root; it must stay inside the project.

fail_on.description: Lowest severity of a scanner finding (AR011) that fails the run. Scanner findings only; it replaces the run's own threshold (--strict, --fail-on) for them, and a scanner's own fail_on wins. strict implies warning.

isolation.description: Process isolation of staged scanners: auto (default) confines when a backend works, require refuses to run unconfined, none never confines.

max_message.description: Default characters of a scanner finding message kept in text output (500 when unset); a scanner's own max_message wins. The JSON report and SARIF output keep the whole text.

max_timeout.description: Longest timeout one run of a scanner may be given, a Go duration from 1s to 6h (default 15m). A scanner's timeout above it is refused (AR9E0). Only the policy can raise it.

preset.description: Embedded scanner profiles that run with --external without an entry. Presets never contain a scanner that can send content off the machine. Default off.

required.description: Scanner names whose absence, outdated version or failure is an error.

security.description: Settings for the security checks AR001 to AR011.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts URLs may point to (`example.com`, `*.example.com`). Empty disables the outbound host check (AR008).

allowed_tools.description: allowed-tools entries that may be unrestricted, for example `Bash` (AR007).

directive_tags.description: Element names added to <system> and <override> that AR018 treats as imitating a privileged message.

injection_phrases.description: Extra case-insensitive phrases for the prompt-injection detector (AR004).

scan_imports.description: Content imported through includes and installed skills is scanned by default and `generate` refuses to write it when a finding is an error. Unset keeps each finding's severity; `error` or `warn` replaces the severity of every finding in imports; `off` opts out.

secret_patterns.description: Extra secret detectors added to the built-in set (AR001).

trusted_orgs.description: Organizations (repository owners, case-insensitive) a skill or include may call itself official, verified or trusted for (AR033). Replaces the built-in list; unset keeps it.

severity.description: Severity override per finding code or name.

skill_roots.description: Globs, relative to the project root, of the directories that hold skill directories a harness loads from (".claude/skills", "plugins/*/skills"). AR808 checks a hand-written skill or command only in these directories; unset, the harness's own roots, a plugin's skills/ and local skill sources are used. Authored content is always checked.

tracked_only.description: Report no findings in files that are not tracked in the repository index, so results do not depend on untracked files a local run left behind (a __pycache__, a build artifact). The files are still read; findings in them are dropped after the run. Files named by --changed are kept; outside a repository work tree it is ignored with a warning. validate --tracked-only sets it for one run.

traps.description: Harness trap checks (AR9C1...): files a harness silently ignores.

extra_harnesses.description: Harnesses (cursor, copilot) whose traps run although no preset for them is configured, for hand-written files.

max_table_age_days.description: Report (AR9C0) a trap or harness-limits row whose verified_on date is older than this many days. 0 (default) turns the check off; the maintainer task harness:verify uses 90.

llm.description: Model access for features that call a language model. Nothing calls out unless allow_network is true. Keys are never stored here: api_key_env names an environment variable (AR9L0).

allow_network.description: Must be true for any provider call (default false).

allow_plain_http.description: User scope only. Together with plain_http_hosts, lets an API key be sent over plain http to a listed non-loopback gateway.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. Never the key itself.

base_url.description: API root of an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. an in-VPC gateway. No credentials or query string.

max_calls.description: Stop after this many provider calls (0 = unlimited).

max_cost_usd.description: Stop before estimated spend would exceed this (0 = unlimited).

max_retries.description: Retries after the first attempt (default 3, -1 disables).

max_tokens.description: Stop before prompt plus completion tokens would exceed this (0 = unlimited).

plain_http_hosts.description: User scope only. Allow-list (host or host:port) for allow_plain_http.

price_input_per_mtok.description: USD per million prompt tokens; overrides the built-in price table.

price_output_per_mtok.description: USD per million completion tokens; overrides the built-in price table.

provider.description: Provider prefix for provider/model routing (liter-llm routes on it).

llms_txt.description: llms.txt output written by the llms-txt preset and linted by `validate --strict` (AR9P0-AR9P6).

dir.description: Directory llms.txt is written to, relative to the project root. Defaults to the project root. Must not be inside the configuration directory or .git.

full.description: Also write llms-full.txt, holding the full text of every listed item.

include.description: Content kinds to list. Defaults to rules, context and skills; agents and commands are listed in the Optional section.

summary.description: Blockquote under the title. Defaults to the project description.

title.description: H1 of the file. Defaults to the project name.

enforce.description: Defaults to true whenever ai-rulez.lock exists (set false to opt out). Report content drift as AR981/AR982 in `validate`, make `lock --check` fail on a lock without content pins, make `generate` refuse a remote include or installed skill the lock does not pin (AR010 becomes an error), and make the skills server (`mcp --serve-skills`) refuse a served skill whose digest is not the one recorded in ai-rulez.lock (kind served) or that the lock does not pin at all. Run `ai-rulez lock` to record the digests.

include_outputs.description: Also pin digests of generated output files. Defaults to true.

min_release_age.description: Default minimum release age (7d, 12h, 2w) for sources that use a version constraint and set no min_release_age of their own. Holds back tags younger than this (AR733). See docs/lockfile.md.

min_release_age_source.description: Where a tag's release time comes from: auto (default) tries the forge publish time, then the first time this machine saw the tag, then the commit date; the others use one source only. The commit date can be forged by anyone who can push.

refresh_on_generate.description: Make generate re-resolve remote includes, installed skills and skill sources to their latest allowed version and rewrite ai-rulez.lock before writing outputs, as generate --refresh-remote does. The security scan of the new trees runs first and a refusal aborts before any output is written. Needs the network; skipped with --check, --dry-run, --emit-plan, --locked, --frozen, --offline, --watch, --recursive, --user and --plugin. Default false.

scope.description: all (default) pins every authored item; skills pins skills, remote includes and installed skills only.

verify_tags.description: Make generate and lock --check ask the remotes whether a tag pinned in ai-rulez.lock moved (AR732) or was deleted (AR735). Needs the network; default false. The --verify-tags flag turns it on for one run.

marketplace.description: Authoring metadata for the marketplace index emitted for the plugin(s).

catalog_skill.description: Generate a skill listing the plugins and how to enable them (default off). It goes to the preset skill outputs only, never into a plugin bundle.

cursor_index.description: Also write .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json next to the Claude index for members and domain plugins (default off).

from_domains.description: Generate one plugin per domain, named name_prefix + domain. Builtin domains are skipped.

default_enabled.description: Emitted as the marketplace entry's defaultEnabled; false makes Claude Code start the plugin disabled.

enabled.description: Defaults to true when the block is present.

exclude.description: Domain names or globs to leave out.

include.description: Domain names or globs to generate. Empty means all.

name_prefix.description: Prepended to the lower-cased domain name to form the plugin name.

members.description: Sub-project directories for a multi-plugin monorepo. Empty means single-plugin.

output_dir.description: Project-relative directory the domain-plugin marketplace is written to (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json and plugins/<name>/ beneath it). Empty means the project root. Cannot be combined with members.

plugins.description: Plugins declared by hand from domains and root content. An entry named like a from_domains plugin replaces it.

items.description: One plugin definition: the content it bundles by name or glob (an empty selector bundles nothing), its runtimes and metadata. Used by marketplace.plugins and plugins_authoring.

agents.description: Root agents (names or globs) to bundle.

commands.description: Root commands (names or globs) to bundle.

domains.description: Domains (names or globs) whose content the plugin bundles.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks the plugin ships; same shape as the top-level hooks.

mcp_servers.description: Names of root mcp_servers the plugin bundles. Empty bundles none.

relevance.description: When Claude Code suggests the plugin. At least one signal is required.

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

skills.description: Root skills (names or globs) to bundle.

marketplaces.description: Plugin marketplaces to register. Declared sources only; ai-rulez currently records them without emitting marketplace output.

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

source.description: Marketplace source (GitHub repository, git URL, local path, or URL).

marketplaces_authoring.description: Several marketplace indexes from one root, each listing plugin definitions by name. Cannot be combined with [marketplace]. Merges by name across layers.

items.description: One marketplace index listing plugin definitions by name.

output_dir.description: Project-relative directory holding the index and its plugins/<name>/ bundles. Empty means the project root. Unique per marketplace.

plugins.description: Names of the plugin definitions (plugins_authoring or marketplace.plugins) the index lists. An empty list lists nothing.

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

mcp.description: Project-level MCP generation options, distinct from the individual [[mcp_servers]] definitions.

allow.description: Serve only the skills whose name matches one of these path.Match globs, as `mcp --serve-skills --allow` does. The --allow flag overrides it.

authoring.description: Keep the authoring tools on a read-only skills server. Without it, `mcp --serve-skills` with `read_only` registers only find_skill, load_skill, search_skills, read_skill_file and list_skill_resources. A `tools` list wins over both.

daemon.description: Share one long-lived skills server per repository, as `mcp --serve-skills --daemon` does. The --daemon flag overrides it.

daemon_idle_timeout.description: How long the shared daemon outlives its last client, as a Go duration such as `30s` or `5m`. The default is 15 minutes. The daemon also exits when its repository is removed.

deny.description: Never serve the skills whose name matches one of these path.Match globs; wins over allow. The --deny flag overrides it.

discover_skills.description: Make `mcp --serve-skills` also serve the skills already in the repository: "repo" indexes the skill directories of the working tree (root skills/, .claude/skills at any depth and the skill directories of the configured presets, respecting .gitignore and skipping generated copies); "all" adds the installed and included skills whatever their delivery. The --discover-skills flag overrides it.

exclude.description: Globs, relative to the project root, of the paths repository discovery (`mcp --serve-skills --discover-skills`) never reads: skill directories and the context index (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules, agents) alike. `**` crosses directories, `*` and `?` do not, `{a,b}` alternates, a pattern without a slash matches at any depth and a trailing slash matches a directory and everything below it. The --exclude flag adds to this list.

index_cache.description: Where the repository index of `mcp --serve-skills --discover-skills` keeps its cache of item summaries and scan verdicts (never file bodies): "user" is the user cache directory, with a gitignored directory in the project (.ai-rulez/.cache/) as the fallback when it is not writable; "repo" always uses that project directory; "off" keeps no cache. The scan, allow and deny rules run again whenever an item is loaded.

no_watch.description: Do not reload the served skills when their files change, as `mcp --serve-skills --no-watch` does. The --no-watch flag overrides it.

read_only.description: Register only the read-only tools, as `mcp --read-only` does: the server can inspect the project but not change it, and its instructions and prompts follow the tools it has. The --read-only flag overrides it. An organization policy with mcp.read_only = true cannot be loosened by it.

self_server.description: Add ai-rulez's own MCP server (`npx -y ai-rulez@<version> mcp`) to the project .mcp.json. Defaults to true in v5, so a project gets the server out of the box; set it to false (or pass generate --no-self-mcp) to opt out. The entry is merged into the file, so hand-authored servers survive, and .claude/settings.json is not touched.

self_server_command.description: Replace the whole launch command (executable followed by its arguments), for example ["ai-rulez", "mcp"] for a locally installed binary. Mutually exclusive with self_server_version; only applies while the self server is on (the default).

self_server_launcher.description: How the self entry starts ai-rulez. npx (default) runs it through npx; binary-then-npx runs an installed `ai-rulez` when one is on PATH and falls back to npx (pinned by self_server_version), through a `sh -c` script that needs no hand-written wrapper. Mutually exclusive with self_server_command.

self_server_version.description: Pin the ai-rulez version the entry runs (for example "4.19.0" or "latest"). Defaults to the version of the ai-rulez binary that runs generate, or "latest" for a dev build. Only applies while the self server is on (the default).

serve_skills.description: Make a bare `ai-rulez mcp` serve skills, as `mcp --serve-skills` does, so a client entry needs no flag. The --serve-skills flag overrides it, and --serve-skills=false turns it off.

skills_instructions.description: While skills are served, write a short section into every instruction file telling the agent to call find_skill and then load_skill on the MCP server that serves them, with the on-disk fallback path. Set to false to leave the section out.

skills_instructions_text.description: Replace the default skills section. {{server}} is the MCP server that serves the skills and {{skills_dir}} the config directory's skills folder, relative to the instruction file. Requires skills_instructions to be on.

tools.description: The only tools the server registers, for example ["find_skill", "load_skill", "find_context", "load_context"] for a server that can only read. An unknown name fails the server start and names the valid ones. The --tools flag overrides it.

mcp_servers.description: Inline Model Context Protocol (MCP) server definitions generated into assistant MCP configuration files.

args.description: Command line arguments for a local MCP server. An argument may contain the ${PROJECT_ROOT} placeholder, resolved to the project root at generation time.

command.description: Command to start a local stdio MCP server (e.g., 'npx', 'uvx', 'node'). May contain the ${PROJECT_ROOT} placeholder, resolved to the project root at generation time.

description.description: Optional description of the MCP server capabilities

domain.description: Restrict this server to the named domain: it is emitted only when the active profile or role selects that domain. Omit to make it global. When both domain and profiles are set, both must match.

enabled.description: Whether this MCP server is emitted into generated MCP outputs (default: true)

env.description: Environment variables for the MCP server. Values may contain ${VAR} placeholders; placeholder names must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* and are resolved by ai-rulez generate from repeated --env KEY=VALUE, process env, then dotenv files. ${PROJECT_ROOT} resolves to the project root unless a real PROJECT_ROOT is supplied.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent to a remote (http or sse) MCP server, typically for auth. Values may contain ${VAR} placeholders, resolved like env; a header holding a placeholder or a credential (Authorization, Cookie, or a name containing TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, KEY or CREDENTIAL) makes the generated MCP file secret, so it must be gitignored.

name.description: MCP server name/identifier (used as unique key)

oauth.description: Pre-registered OAuth client of a hosted (http or sse) server, rendered into the harnesses whose MCP format has an `oauth` block (Claude Code's .mcp.json, VS Code's mcp.json, Codex's config.toml). A harness that cannot express it skips the server with a warning rather than writing one that could not authenticate.

callback_port.description: Fixed local port of the OAuth callback listener, when the provider requires the redirect URI to match a pre-registered port.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID registered with the provider. Required when the provider does not support dynamic client registration.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization.

package.description: Package URL (purl) of the package a command-based server runs, e.g. pkg:npm/%40scope/server@1.4.2. `ai-rulez sbom` uses it for the component's purl instead of guessing from command and args; it is not written to harness files.

profiles.description: Restrict this server to the named profiles. Omit to include it in every profile.

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

transport.description: Transport protocol for MCP server communication (default: stdio)

type.description: Explicit transport written to a harness's `type` key (stdio, http or sse). An alias of `transport`; when both are set they must agree, and an unset `type` falls back to `transport`.

url.description: URL for remote MCP servers using http or sse transport

okf.description: Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle written by the okf preset and linted by `validate` (AR9B0-AR9B9).

dir.description: Bundle directory, relative to the project root. Defaults to docs/okf. Must not be inside the configuration directory or .git.

include.description: Content kinds to export. Defaults to all.

index_style.description: index.md scheme: body (default, the OKF 0.2 listing in the body) or frontmatter (title, version and entries in the frontmatter). Only index.md files differ.

spec.description: OKF spec version to write. Only 0.2 is implemented.

permissions.description: Allow/ask/deny rules in Claude Code permission-rule syntax, owned rule by rule in .claude/settings.json and translated into the native permission format of the other harnesses that have one (see docs/permissions.md).

placement.description: Whether skills and commands are generated into .claude/skills (core) or shipped only through a plugin. Absent means every item is core.

core.description: Names or globs kept in .claude/skills. A pattern matches the item name or domains/<domain>/<name>. Wins over plugin.

default.description: Placement of items no pattern or frontmatter decides. Default core.

honor_targets.description: Apply frontmatter targets to skills in .claude/skills, as is already done for commands. Default false.

plugin.description: Names or globs left out of .claude/skills (for example domains/*).
Authoring metadata for a distributable plugin bundle (producer side). Skills, commands, and agents come from the content tree; this block only carries packaging metadata.

codex.description: Codex layout. manifest: legacy (default, .codex-plugin/plugin.json), root (Agent Plugins plugin.json with the interface under extensions.com.openai, skills/ and mcp.json) or both. marketplace writes .agents/plugins/marketplace.json for a single-plugin repository.

content_root.description: Project-relative directory containing plugin-only skills/, commands/, and agents/

cursor.description: Cursor packaging switches. marketplace writes .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json for a single-plugin repository.

commands.description: Also bundle the plugin's commands as commands/<name>.toml Gemini custom commands (default off). $ARGUMENTS becomes {{args}}.

settings.description: Runtime-provided extension settings allowlisted into the MCP environment. Credential values are supplied by Gemini, never stored in this config.

dependencies.description: PEP 508 requirements for the generated Hermes wheel and project plugin. Direct references (name @ url) are rejected because Hermes does not install them.

requires_python.description: Python requirement for the generated Hermes wheel (default: >=3.11)

hooks.description: Lifecycle hook groups emitted as hooks.json (Claude/Cursor) or inline hooks (Gemini).

event.description: Lifecycle event, e.g. SessionStart. Unknown events are warned about, not rejected.

items.description: One hook handler. Exactly one of 'command' or 'script' is required.

script.description: Project-relative script bundled at hooks/<basename> and invoked via the plugin root.

matcher.description: Filters which occurrences of the event run the group; ignored by events with no matchable subject.

include.description: Globs relative to the plugin's content root of arbitrary files copied verbatim into the Agent Plugins package, keeping their relative path. A './'-relative MCP command can point at an included file (Agent Plugins 4.2, 7.2.1). Empty keeps the package to plugin.json, mcp.json and skills/.

include_domains.description: Domains (names or globs) whose skills, commands and agents are bundled next to the root content. Empty keeps the bundle root-only. A root item wins over a same-named domain item.

include_evals.description: Bundle eval cases: each skill's evals/ directory and the project-level evals/ tree (at <bundle>/evals/). Off by default.

interface.description: Rich UI block shared by Codex and Kimi manifests.

opencode_dependency.description: Version range for the "@opencode/plugin" dependency in the OpenCode root package.json. Empty uses the built-in default.

package_manager.description: Written as packageManager in the OpenCode and Pi root package.json (for example "pnpm@9.15.0"). Empty omits the field. The root package.json is generator-owned.

package_json.description: generate (default) writes the root package.json from the plugin metadata; merge updates only the keys ai-rulez owns (name, version, description, author, repository, keywords, pi, files) and keeps every other key; an authored name is kept unless package_name is set.

package_name.description: npm package name written to package.json. Default: @<owner>/pi-<plugin-name>. With package_json = merge, an authored name is kept when this is unset.

skills_dir.description: Directory each bundled skill is written to, relative to the project root. Default: .pi/skills. Set to "skills" to reuse the tree the other runtimes write and write each skill once.

skills_entry.description: each (default) lists every skill directory in pi.skills and every file in files; directory writes the skills directory once ("./skills" in pi.skills, "skills/" in files).

provenance_headers.description: Write the AI-RULEZ generated-file header into bundled Markdown/JS/TS/PY outputs. Default true; set false to write them byte-identical to their sources (the provenance sidecar still records every output's content hash).

shared_resources.description: Directories relative to the plugin's content root whose files are copied into every bundled skill, at <skill>/<directory>/... A relative SKILL.md link to the shared directory ('../../references/x.md') is rewritten to the copy ('references/x.md'). A name clash with a file the skill already has is an error. Empty copies nothing.

skills_dir_owned.description: Declare each skills directory the bundle writes fully owned: verify --plugin reports an entry it did not generate there as extra, and generate --plugin removes it. Default false: skill directories and files the bundle does not generate are never touched.

spec.description: Agent Plugins specification version of the agent-plugins, copilot and root-layout codex bundles. Default: 1.0.0.

version.description: Semantic version, e.g. 1.0.0. Mutually exclusive with version_from.

version_from.description: Project-relative manifest whose version replaces 'version': package.json (version), pyproject.toml (project.version) or Cargo.toml (package.version). Mutually exclusive with version.

plugins.description: Plugins to install from a configured marketplace. Declarations only: v5 writes no file for them (4.x wrote .claude/plugins.json and .codex/plugins.json, which no tool reads) and generate warns that the table has no effect. Enable plugins with [claude.settings] enable_plugins, or in the target tool's own settings. Distinct from the producer `[plugin]` authoring block.

enabled.description: Whether the plugin declaration is emitted. Defaults to true.

marketplace.description: Name of the marketplace the plugin comes from (see `marketplaces`).

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

plugins_authoring.description: Several plugin definitions from one root, generated and verified in one `generate --plugin` / `verify --plugin` run. Cannot be combined with [plugin]. Merges by name across layers; remove = true drops an entry.

items.description: One plugin definition: the content it bundles by name or glob (an empty selector bundles nothing), its runtimes and metadata. Used by marketplace.plugins and plugins_authoring.

agents.description: Root agents (names or globs) to bundle.

commands.description: Root commands (names or globs) to bundle.

domains.description: Domains (names or globs) whose content the plugin bundles.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks the plugin ships; same shape as the top-level hooks.

mcp_servers.description: Names of root mcp_servers the plugin bundles. Empty bundles none.

relevance.description: When Claude Code suggests the plugin. At least one signal is required.

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

skills.description: Root skills (names or globs) to bundle.

presets.description: List of presets to generate (built-in tool names or custom preset objects)

provider.description: Project-relative path to a declarative provider spec (schema/provider.schema.json). Gives the preset full built-in parity (root file, skills/agents/commands, MCP sidecars).

oneOf.description: "!name" drops the shared preset of that name

profiles.description: Named profiles mapping profile names to lists of domain entries. An entry is a local or included domain name, a builtin pack written as `builtin:<name>` (e.g. `builtin:rust`, loaded only for the profiles that name it) or one pack item as `builtin:<pack>/<item>` (e.g. `builtin:docker/container-standards`), `*` for every domain the config knows, or `!name` to exclude one. A profile made only of exclusions is invalid: start it with `*`.

publish.description: What `ai-rulez publish` ships and its policy gates (see docs/publish.md). It has no credential keys: registries and forges authenticate through their own CLIs and environment.

allow_dirty.description: Publish from a tree with uncommitted changes (the manifest records dirty = true).

emitters.description: Emitters run by publish; each writes files under <dist>/emit/ and never contacts the target system.

options.description: Emitter settings, such as blueprint for the port emitter.

repo.description: OWNER/REPO (or HOST/OWNER/REPO). Default: [plugin] repository, else the origin remote.

channels.description: Channel name to the git ref its pinned marketplace index points at. A channel not listed pins the release tag.

registry.description: Registry URL (https only). Default: the npm client's.

ref.description: Repository to push to, host/path without tag or digest, such as ghcr.io/acme/skills/conventions. The tag is the plugin version.

require_approved.description: Fail publish unless every item the [governance] policy selects is approved in ai-rulez.lock.

require_signature.description: Fail publish unless the bundle is signed (--sign key or keyless).

runtimes.description: Restrict the published bundle to these plugin runtimes. Default: the [plugin] runtimes.

recursive_exclude.description: Directories, relative to this project root, that `generate --recursive` run from here never searches for configuration: a glob such as `svc/*/gen` or a plain directory such as `tests/fixtures`. The --exclude flag adds to it.

review.description: Settings of `ai-rulez review`: the rubric, what an item sends to a judge, exclusions, spend ceilings, the secret policy and the gate and fix settings. See docs/review.md.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts a judged run may send to (host or host:port; `provider-default` names the provider's own endpoint). Honoured only from the user config file; a repository value is ignored.

content.description: descriptions (default) sends the name, description and frontmatter keys; full also sends the body.

exclude.description: Name globs of items the review skips.

max_growth_percent.description: How much a fix may grow an item (default 25, and never less than 200 bytes).

model.description: Model that writes the fix. It must differ from the judge model unless --allow-same-model is given.

calibration_max_age_days.description: How old a calibration record may be (default: the rubric's calibration.max_age_days, else 90).

level.description: Lowest severity ceiling of a dimension whose stable fail verdict fails the gate (default warning). A judge never reports above warning, so error gates no judged verdict.

require_calibration.description: Default true: --gate is refused unless a calibration record matches the rubric, prompt, golden set, model and content mode. false lets it run without one (AR9G9 still reports it).

max_calls.description: Call ceiling of one run; an estimate above it is refused. 0 means unset. Same trust rule as max_cost_usd.

max_cost_usd.description: Spend ceiling of one run in USD; an estimate above it is refused. 0 means unset. A repository value can only lower the default (0.50); the user config file and --max-cost can set any value.

on_secret.description: withhold (default): an item holding a credential is never sent. redact: the credential is masked with [REDACTED:AR001] and the item is sent, marked redacted. An item with hidden characters is always withheld.

rubric.description: Rubric id: builtin:skill-quality (default) or a directory under .ai-rulez/rubrics.

role_manifest.description: Options for the roles.json manifest (a separate table because roles is an array).

enabled.description: Write <config dir>/roles.json on generate: every role with its resolved item ids, byte sizes and token estimates.

skill_mode_fallback.description: What generate --role does with a skill whose skill_mode is off on a harness with no documented per-skill setting: drop (default) leaves it out, serve moves it to served delivery. Lives here because TOML cannot use roles as both an array and a table.

roles.description: Roles map a person's job to a slice of the shared content. Select one with `ai-rulez generate --role <name>`. ai-rulez never decides who holds a role; an external tool picks the name (see `match`).

agents.description: Include/exclude selectors for agents. Entries are item ids or path.Match globs; an entry containing / matches domain/id. An empty include keeps everything the role's domains provide.

checks.description: Include/exclude selectors for checks. Entries are item ids or path.Match globs; an entry containing / matches domain/id. An empty include keeps everything the role's domains provide.

commands.description: Include/exclude selectors for commands. Entries are item ids or path.Match globs; an entry containing / matches domain/id. An empty include keeps everything the role's domains provide.

delivery.description: Skill id or glob (domain/id for one domain) to how the skill reaches this role's agent: static (written to the skill trees), served (fetched over MCP on demand with `ai-rulez mcp --serve-skills --role`, never listed) or both. Same specificity rule as skill_mode; a skill's own `delivery` frontmatter wins, and the entries are inherited through extends with the child winning.

domains.description: Domains the role selects, with the same meaning as a profile's list (builtin:<name> allowed).

extends.description: Name of one parent role (one level only). Domains and excludes are unioned, includes are unioned when both set one, skill_mode and delivery are merged with the child winning. match is not inherited.

match.description: Hints for an external identity tool. ai-rulez stores and republishes them in roles.json and never interprets them.

pin.description: Record the digest of this role's rendered outputs in ai-rulez.lock, checked by `lock --check` and `generate --check --locked --role`. Not inherited through extends.

remove.description: Set to true to delete the shared entry with the same name

rules.description: Include/exclude selectors for rules. Entries are item ids or path.Match globs; an entry containing / matches domain/id. An empty include keeps everything the role's domains provide.

skill_mode.description: Skill id or glob to Claude Code skillOverrides state. An exact id beats a glob, a longer glob beats a shorter one, ties go to the lexically first pattern.

skills.description: Include/exclude selectors for skills. Entries are item ids or path.Match globs; an entry containing / matches domain/id. An empty include keeps everything the role's domains provide.

rules.description: Controls how rules are written to generated outputs

baz.description: Per-rule controls for the baz preset.

include.description: Names of the rules and context files the baz preset selects for its path-scoped AGENTS.md files when baz_default is none. The same opt-in is `baz: true` in an item's frontmatter. A `!baz` target always excludes an item.

baz_budget.description: Byte budget of the AGENTS.md files the baz preset writes; generate warns when their total exceeds it. 0 (default) disables the warning.

baz_dedupe.description: When true, a path-scoped item whose globs point into several directories under one parent is written once to the shared parent AGENTS.md instead of a copy in each. Defaults to false.

baz_dedupe_max.description: When above 0, a path-scoped item that would be copied into more than this many directories is written once to the directory covering all of them, up to the repository root (the root AGENTS.md). Independent of baz_dedupe; with baz_unscoped = skip the root fallback is not used. 0 (default) disables it.

baz_default.description: Which items the baz preset selects for its path-scoped AGENTS.md files. all (default) lets every item through; none only items whose frontmatter `targets` name baz.

baz_rest.description: What the baz preset does with a glob-activated item it does not nest (unselected under baz_default = none, or excluded by `!baz`). root (default) leaves it inlined in the root AGENTS.md; skip leaves it out of that file when baz is the only preset writing it. Only applies with baz_scoped = nested.

baz_scoped.description: Where the baz preset puts path-scoped rules and context. nested (default) writes them to the AGENTS.md of the directory their globs point into, which Baz scopes to that directory; root keeps them in the root AGENTS.md with an Applies to line.
